Half columns 16 80 samples set NA. data follows model sampler assumes, fit look good. show steps, show well method works real data. Row column names required: fit uses keep track cell .
code: set.seed(2) n <- 80 p <- 300 mu <- ifelse(runif(p) < 0.5, rnorm(p, -2, 0.7), rnorm(p, 2, 0.7)) U <- matrix(rnorm(n * 2), n, 2) V <- matrix(rnorm(p * 2, 0, 0.5), p, 2) noise <- 0.4 * sqrt(4 / 6) * matrix(rt(n * p, df = 6), n, p) truth <- plogis(matrix(mu, n, p, byrow = TRUE) + U %*% t(V) + noise) dimnames(truth) <- list(sprintf("s%02d", seq_len(n)), sprintf("cpg%03d", seq_len(p)))  obj <- truth na_cols <- sample.int(p, p / 2) for (j in na_cols) obj[sample.int(n, 16), j] <- NA obj[1:4, 1:4] #>         cpg001    cpg002    cpg003     cpg004 #> s01 0.21050697 0.9090441 0.9077718 0.06148590 #> s02 0.13928224 0.7599630 0.7580556 0.07896476 #> s03 0.21884599 0.8688346 0.9009699 0.05805358 #> s04 0.04057579 0.8940313 0.7209590 0.09907192 mean(is.na(obj)) #> [1] 0.1
